content: Alertmanager concepts: 'for' duration is a pending period before an alert fires; grouping (group_by + group_wait) collapses simultaneous related alerts into one notification - setting group_wait to 0 for 'instant' alerting defeats grouping; inhibition suppresses symptom alerts when a root-cause alert is already firing (e.g. master node down inhibits per-pod pages); resolved notifications are opt-in per receiver via send_resolved:true. Inhibition maps to the 'blind mode' idea: when the UI-absent alert is active, suppress per-member death/left alerts.
